wizard.resumeHint: You can pick it up any time from Help.

welcome.title: Welcome to {{brand}}
welcome.body: Tell us a bit about you in under a minute and we will tailor your space. Everything is optional and you can skip any screen.

occupation.title: What do you do?
occupation.body: So we can pick better examples for you.

goals.title: What do you want to achieve?

teamSize.title: How many people are on your team?

firstAction.title: What do you want to do first?
firstAction.body: We will take you straight there when we are done.

language.title: Which language do you prefer?
language.body: You can change it later in Preferences.

start.title: All set. How do we start?
start.body: Choose how you want to see {{brand}} and where to begin.
start.scratchBody: An empty space, ready for you.
start.demoBody: Creates a sample board, document and template. They are marked as demo and you can delete them all at once.
start.demoError: We could not create the demo. What was created has been cleaned up; try again or start from scratch.
start.noWorkspace: You need an active workspace to create the demo.

mode.label: Killio mode
mode.reducedDesc: Just the essentials: boards, cards, documents and team.
mode.fullDesc: Everything: meshes, scripts, KQL, rooms, graph, integrations, Gantt, Summary and Projects views, advanced AI.
mode.note: Switching mode only hides or shows options: nothing is deleted or moved. Change it any time.
mode.fromTeam: Your team uses {{mode}} mode by default.
mode.teamDefaultDesc: Applies to people who have not chosen their own mode.
mode.hiddenTitle: This section belongs to Full mode
mode.hiddenBody: You are in Reduced mode, which hides the advanced parts. Your data is untouched.

help.title: Help
help.tourDesc: A short walk through the essentials.
help.demoDeleteConfirm: The demo board, document and template will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
help.demoDeletePartial: Part of the demo was deleted; {{count}} items could not be deleted.
help.demoBanner: You are looking at a demo space.

boards.title: Boards
boards.body: Organize work in lists and cards. Drag cards between lists as they progress.

cards.title: Cards
cards.body: Each card holds details, assignees, dates and notes. Templates save you from repeating yourself.

documents.title: Documents
documents.body: Write notes, guides and minutes, and share them with your team.

team.title: Your team
team.body: Invite other people and decide who can view or edit.

palette.title: Command palette
palette.body: Press Ctrl+K (or ⌘K) to search, jump anywhere or ask Killio.

modes.title: Reduced or Full mode
modes.body: When you want more tools, switch in App preferences. Nothing is lost.

cards.c2s: Use the + button on a list.
cards.c5: Delete the demo when I am done

demo.p1:
# Welcome to your demo space
This document, the board and the template were created so you can try things safely.
demo.p2:
## What you can try
- Move cards between lists.
- Edit this text.
- Create a card from the template.
demo.p3: When you are done, delete everything at once from **Help → Delete the demo space**.
demo.templateDesc: Sample template that creates dated cards.
